experiment: Four-state GRU versus soft-gated four-state GRU
selection: Minimum original-three-state autonomous validation MSE; extra thermal state excluded from selection score. All20 selections frozen before test.
test: All20 selections frozen before either architecture tests; same ten grouped rotations; test not historically pristine
training_balance: Within each TRAIN history, active and quiet transitions share equal total weight if both exist; replica-balanced. Active means release>1e-6kg/s OR absolute water/fuel change>1e-5kg per step.
evaluation: Unweighted full histories, active and quiet separately; train-defined normalization only
history: four states ending at current time; repeat initial state for missing history, never future truth
architecture: Both GRU25->32 with4state readouts and3internal gate logits. Control ignores gate outputs; shared initial tensors, fresh weights. Gated gas starts with sigmoid(4) factor .982; initial full-state persistence differs for nonzero gas histories and is disclosed.
physics: No positivity or monotonicity clamp. Water/dryfuel deltas multiplied by sigmoid gates; gas physical next rate multiplied by gasgate, not its delta; heating delta ungated. Report invalid states and premature suppression.
burn_in: GRU memory initialized zero; teacher-forced prefix up to each training window recomputed with current parameters under no_grad; gradients within window only. Full autonomous evaluation uses predicted states from initial time, never true future states.
thermal_loss: Four-state standardized encoded squared error sum/3 unchanged in both. Gated adds0.1*mean masked BCE of3activity gates; no sweep. Weak rates[1e-5,1e-4) excluded from gate supervision only; still included in state loss.
scorecard: Frozen scorecard-v1, meaningful stable active/quiet/weak and transition windows at all forecast horizons. Primary selection remains original3state full autonomous validation MSE. Activity thresholds never tuned on predictions.
gate_targets: Trailing10s truth rates per initial mass: water loss, dryfuel loss, and gasintegral/.75. Active>=1e-4/s, quiet<1e-5/s; ambiguous excluded from gateBCE. Different material labels, no fixed shutdown time.
